# TextInput

- Inherits [`TextLabel`](textlabel.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("TextInput")`

A text field the player can type in, with one line or several: a chat box, a name or a server address.

It supports the usual editing keys: selection with Shift and with the mouse, movement and deletion by word with Ctrl, Ctrl+A, copy, cut and paste through the system clipboard, undo and redo, a double press to select a word and a triple press to select a line. It treats an accented letter or an emoji as one character and shows an input method's composition at the caret. While it has focus, it takes the keyboard, so typing does not trigger game actions.

Setting `Text` from a script moves the caret to the end and clears the undo history.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

| `Masked` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether each character is drawn as `MaskCharacter`, for a password. Copy and cut are disabled; paste still works. A phone shows its password keyboard. |

## Methods

### `CaptureFocus()`

Gives the field keyboard focus, as a press on it does. A field that had focus loses it with `Enum.FocusLossReason.Script`. It takes effect at the next frame.

### `IsFocused(): boolean`

Returns whether the field has keyboard focus.

### `ReleaseFocus(submitted: boolean?)`

Releases keyboard focus. `FocusLost` fires with `submitted`, which is false if omitted, and `Enum.FocusLossReason.Script`. It takes effect at the next frame.

## Events

Signals are deferred: a handler runs at the next resumption point, not
inside the call that fired the signal.

### `FocusLost(submitted: boolean, reason: Enum.FocusLossReason)`

Fires when the field loses keyboard focus. `submitted` is true when the player pressed Return and false when focus was lost another way, such as a press elsewhere. `reason` says which of the four ways it was.

### `Focused()`

Fires when the field gains keyboard focus.

### `InputRejected(rejected: string)`

Fires with the text that `MaxLength` kept out of an edit.

### `Submitted(text: string)`

Fires when the player presses Return, with the text at that moment. It fires whether or not the field then releases focus.

### `TextChanged(text: string)`

Fires when the player changes the text by typing, pasting, cutting or undoing, with the new text. It does not fire when a script sets `Text`; `GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text")` fires for both.
